summary: This recap highlights the SCA BootCampUs retreat designed to prepare high school seniors for the challenges of post-high school and college life. Participants and organizers discuss topics including Sephardic Jewish heritage, social media literacy, anti-Semitism, and advocating for Israel. The program offers learning sessions, Q&A opportunities with speakers, and outdoor activities to help students feel supported and confident.
